import json, os, random, subprocess, sys, bisect
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp')
from check import decode
from audit import decode_image
import solver, randlayout, harness

harness.SMALL = False
rng = random.Random(94)
ncases = rng.randint(1, 2)
cases, allversions = [], []
for _ in range(ncases):
    c, vs = harness.gen_case(rng, 0)
    cases.append(c); allversions.append(vs)
case, versions = cases[0], allversions[0]
per_version = [[] for _ in versions]
for v, rep, addrs in case["bursts"]:
    per_version[v].append((rep, addrs))
costs = tuple(case["costs"])
env = dict(os.environ, FIDX_ENGINE='/workspace/tmp/engine')
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', harness.ENTRY],
                   input=json.dumps({"cases": [harness.to_json_case(case)]}).encode(),
                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env)
actual = decode(p.stdout)["cases"][0]
print('plan objective', actual["objective"])
print('R', [len(v[0]) for v in versions], 'bursts per version',
      [[(r, len(a)) for r, a in pv] for pv in per_version])
for vi, (ver, pv) in enumerate(zip(actual["versions"], per_version)):
    starts = [int(x, 16) for x in ver["starts"]]
    hops = ver["hops"]
    nd, size = decode_image(ver["image"], starts, hops)
    order = sorted(nd.keys())
    recs = [{"kind": nd[o]["kind"], "mode": nd[o]["mode"], "cached": nd[o]["cached"],
             "lo": nd[o]["lo"], "span": nd[o]["span"],
             "children": [order.index(c) for c in nd[o]["children"]],
             "pages": nd[o]["pages"]} for o in order]
    runs = [(r, [bisect.bisect_right(starts, a) - 1 for a in addrs]) for r, addrs in pv]
    touch, qpref = solver.traffic(len(starts), runs)
    w = sum(solver.node_cost(n, touch, qpref, costs) for n in recs)
    print('v%d R=%d nodes=%d pages=%d work=%d  tree=%s' % (
        vi, len(starts), len(recs), size, w,
        [(n['kind'], n['mode'], n['cached'], n['lo'], n['span'], n['pages']) for n in recs]))
EOF
